examples.english: Through the centuries, the Church has become aware that Mary, "full of grace" through God, had been redeemed from her conception. It's what the dogma of the Immaculate Conception confesses.
examples.ref: 1993, José Manuel Estepa Llaurens et al., transl., Catecismo de la Iglesia Católica, Librería Editora Vaticana, accessed at Vatican.va, archived from the original on 09 Aug 2024, §491:
examples.text: A lo largo de los siglos, la Iglesia ha tomado conciencia de que María "llena de gracia" por Dios había sido redimida desde su concepción. Es lo que confiesa el dogma de la Inmaculada Concepción.
examples.translation: Through the centuries, the Church has become aware that Mary, "full of grace" through God, had been redeemed from her conception. It's what the dogma of the Immaculate Conception confesses.

examples.english: The dogma of the Immaculate Conception dates back to 1854, when it was proclaimed by Pope Pius IX.
examples.ref: 2004 December 8, DyN & Télam, “Los católicos veneran a la Virgen María”, in La Nación, archived from the original on 26 Mar 2025:
examples.text: El dogma de la Inmaculada Concepción data de 1854, cuando fue proclamado por el papa Pío IX.
examples.translation: The dogma of the Immaculate Conception dates back to 1854, when it was proclaimed by Pope Pius IX.
